name: frontend-flat-trace
purpose: Capture an HLE trace OF THE FLAT-BLACK ERA itself, so the replay can answer the C-450V4 mechanism question: does the flat frame already exist in the active render target before Present, or is it introduced by the final composite/present path? Navigation is frontend_navigate.json verbatim through select-third; only the final observation dwell is replaced. Host-only F9 arms the existing default-OFF SR_HLE_TRACE_HOTKEY recorder - no guest write, no fabricated state, no production change.

steps.name: clear-dialog
steps.purpose: Accept the storage dialog. Confirmed when the guest opens the device blade, which is the guest's own decision and therefore a real transition, not a guess.

steps.name: settle-modepage
steps.purpose: Let the mode-select page finish coming up before navigating it.

steps.name: select-mode
steps.purpose: Press A on whatever is focused. Blind by necessity - the item text does not render (atlas defect C-450UB/UC).

steps.name: nav-down
steps.purpose: Move the selection. DOWN is an EXTENDED key - without KEYEVENTF_EXTENDEDKEY the guest never sees it (iter-450V3).

steps.name: nav-up-select
steps.purpose: And the other direction, in case the first item was the wrong one.

steps.name: await-main-hud-request
steps.purpose: Waits for the GUEST to request the in-game HUD package set. This is a MAIN-HUD REQUEST and nothing more: main_hud plus LR 0x826AFB40 are APT witnesses, NOT proof of gameplay, a level, a camera or a player entity (director ruling, iter-453 - the earlier "gameplay entry" wording is withdrawn). Waiting on this rather than on a colour means the scenario pins no level state, no present number and no pixel value.

steps.name: await-flat-era
steps.purpose: Then wait for the flat frame itself. Deliberately NOT keyed to fnv=3F1965ED15C74383: that hash was observed on one roll and DOGMA non-determinism may change the colour without changing the phenomenon. 'distinct=1 fnv=' is the exact field boundary from the PRESENT_SIG format string - bare 'distinct=1' would also match distinct=100.

steps.name: arm-trace
steps.purpose: Host-only F9 (KEYS table mask=0, so it maps to no pad bit and the guest never sees it). Confirmation is the host log line, not [KBPAD_OBS] - a mask=0 key is unconfirmable by design.

steps.name: trace-open
steps.purpose: The recorder opens at the NEXT Present after arming, so OPENED is a separate event from the hotkey hit.

steps.name: bank-frames
steps.purpose: Wait for the recorder to CLOSE the file rather than dwelling a guessed interval. hle_video.cpp:2138 emits this immediately after fclose() once presents >= SR_HLE_TRACE_FRAMES, so it is proof the trace is complete, not an assumption that it is.
